rules.title: Boston Fair Housing Regulations - Prohibition of Housing Discrimination
rules.requirement: It is illegal to discriminate against tenants or buyers based on protected characteristics including race, color, religion, disability, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, rental assistance, family status, and military status when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for housing.
rules.summary_plain: In Boston, landlords and sellers cannot discriminate against you based on your race, gender, family status, or other protected traits when you rent or buy housing.
rules.summary_plain_es: En Boston, los propietarios y vendedores no pueden discriminarte por tu raza, género, estado familiar u otras características protegidas al alquilar o comprar una vivienda.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all housing transactions within the City of Boston.
rules.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing. You can’t discriminate someone based on their: Race, Color, Religion, Disability, National Origin, Ancestry, Sex, Gender Identity, Gender Expression, Age, Sexual Orientation, Marital Status, Rental Assistance, Family Status, Military Status
